name: Stripe Payment Links (buy.stripe.com)
notes: Card fill proven in the 2026-06 campaign; no receipt-verified purchase yet.

steps.addToCart: None — the link IS the checkout. Donation/pay-what-you-want links show a custom-amount box (input[inputmode=decimal]); fill the explicit amount first.
steps.payment: Direct inputs on Stripe's domain, no iframe: #cardNumber, #cardExpiry ('06 / 31'), #billingName, #billingPostalCode. Fill via pressSequentially; card-number token, then the CVV token into #cardCvc immediately after.
